semantic_roles.city_pre_d1: output token immediately before the first token overlapping the parser-registered city span
semantic_roles.p0_item_end: the committed endpoint of item k, used as the earliest query for target city k+1
semantic_roles.unit_pre_d1: output token immediately before the target city-bearing semantic unit, including its marker or opening delimiter
semantic_roles.post_open_delimiter: last token overlapping a separable opening bracket or invariant bullet; fused delimiter/content tokens are explicit N/A
semantic_roles.record_clause_pre_d1: output token immediately before the literal clause 'In the 2024 city score audit' when it occurs inside the target event
semantic_roles.block_pre_d1: output token before the first compiled event; exploratory and not event-specific
semantic_roles.city_target_span: all output tokens overlapping the city characters
semantic_roles.rank_evidence_core_span: semantic ordinal/count content after edge whitespace and removable edge punctuation normalization
semantic_roles.rank_evidence_surface_span: whitespace-trimmed parser evidence surface retained for visible-surface controls
semantic_roles.rank_visible_format_shell_tokens: tokenized evidence surface minus its nested semantic core; an explicit syntax/delimiter control, possibly empty
semantic_roles.pre_marker_state: output token immediately before the first token overlapping rank_evidence_core_span
semantic_roles.post_update_commit_state: last output token overlapping the selected event semantic span
semantic_roles.continue_to_next_city: tokens after current commit through the end of the next city; next-city-only tokens are retained separately
semantic_roles.stop_to_answer_query_v3: tokens after the final observed commit through answer_query_v3
semantic_roles.semantic_target_only: next-city tokens for continue, or answer_query_v3 tokens for stop; interstitial tokens are retained separately
semantic_roles.anchor_equivalence: candidate roles resolving to one output token are executed once and retain all semantic aliases

rules.surface_grammar_axis: event association plus actual rank/city character order; trajectory marker_kind alone never selects a causal token
rules.semantic_span_normalization: strip leading/trailing Unicode whitespace from parser item, city-unit, and rank-evidence surface; strip edge punctuation from rank evidence only when an alphanumeric core remains; preserve parser/surface/core boundaries and trim counts; do not trim city or answer_query_v3

cohort_axis.secondary_structural_marker_neutral: one-to-one structural fallback without a rank-supported episode
cohort_axis.secondary_structural_recap: structural sequence that extends an earlier rank episode; recap sites are not pooled with the primary running trace
cohort_axis.secondary_local_partial_unique: observed local transitions only; no correct terminal-count claim
cohort_axis.occurrence_retrieval_only_duplicates: occurrence retrieval only; emitted rank is not unique-count state
cohort_axis.secondary_evidence_sequence_exploratory: exact score-supported first-mention sequence; retrieval, continue, and terminal stop are exploratory, with no rank-marker claim
cohort_axis.secondary_evidence_sequence_partial_expl: partial score-supported first-mention sequence; local retrieval and continue only, with no terminal-count or rank-marker claim

rules.non_use_guarantee: gold N and final Total are not used to construct events, choose grammar, or place running causal sites
